record.one_liner: Salesforce provides an extensive API library allowing client applications to integrate via OAuth 2.0 and REST APIs.
record.blocker: Insufficient information in sources regarding testing, shipping access, and breadth.

auth_methods.quote: Authorization Through External Client Apps or Connected Apps and OAuth 2.0 For a client application to access REST API resources, it must be authorized as a safe visitor. To implement this authorization, use either an external client app or a connected app and an OAuth 2.0 authorization flow.
